lede: Wall Street surged after Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang as CEO, lifting the S&P 500 4.7%, while gold extended its bounce from a 14-month low to around $3,645. The dollar is holding near 19-month highs as markets keep a 25bp December Fed hike almost fully priced ahead of Wednesday's PCE data.
snapshot_time: Gold 03:23 TRT · FX & Brent early Tue · US500 = Mon 23 Nov close

focus.text: Up 0.4% near $3,645 after Monday's ~3.5% rebound from a 14-month low as tech-driven margin selling eased. Still capped below $3,685–3,700; US consumer confidence 18:00 TRT, PCE on Wednesday.
Steady at ~1.0912 after a fresh 2026 low at 1.0884, sitting just below its 1.0931 pivot. Weak euro-area services PMIs weigh; German Ifo at 12:00 TRT.

news.text: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO; the stock soared about 31%, the S&P 500 closed 4.7% higher at 7,237 and the Nasdaq rose about 6.5%.
Futures still price roughly a 95% chance of a 25bp December hike, but bets on a 50bp move have faded to about 5%; NY Fed's Williams stayed hawkish.
US flash composite PMI eased to a four-month low of 54.6; euro-area services missed at 51.2 and France's composite slumped to 46.2.
Brent slid 3.5% on Monday to a three-month low near $89.4 as US–Iran diplomacy over Hormuz shipping continued; it holds around $89 today.
CrowdStrike agreed an all-stock deal for Zscaler valued near $44bn; Zscaler jumped about 18% while CrowdStrike fell about 9%.
Bitcoin spiked to about $64,500 on Monday alongside the tech rally, then faded back near $60,000; over $760m of crypto positions were liquidated.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.79bn of net outflows last week, a fourth straight weekly drain, taking November's total near –$4.1bn.
Solana spot ETFs drew a $4.4m weekly inflow, ending six weeks of outflows while Bitcoin, Ether and XRP funds kept bleeding.
The crypto fear & greed index sits at 11 (extreme fear) and the Coinbase Bitcoin premium has been negative for 60 days straight.
The ECB approved on-chain assets as eligible collateral from June 2027, and the CFTC sent final prediction-market rules to the White House.
The Ethereum Foundation doubled the size of its protocol security team; Ether trades around $1,690 after giving back Monday's gains.
